An area with Namdaemun Market and Sungnyemun, within walking distance of both Myeongdong and Seoul Station. Main sights include Namdaemun Market, Sungnyemun and the Hoehyeon Station area. Nearby areas are Seoul Station (about 0.8 km), Myeongdong (about 0.8 km) and Euljiro (about 1.5 km).
On arrival day：The market's kalguksu alley and braised cutlassfish alley are perfect for dinner on your arrival day.
flow: Arrival
At both Terminal 1 and Terminal 2, we wait at the arrivals lobby exit on the 1st floor with a board showing your name.
The Ride
We load your luggage and head to your Namdaemun hotel. It is 55.0 km from Terminal 1, about 55 min without traffic.
Hotel
Drop-off at the entrance. The market's kalguksu alley and braised cutlassfish alley are perfect for dinner on your arrival day.
faq: What languages can I use?
Japanese and Korean. From booking to day-of contact, we handle everything on LINE in Japanese and Korean. Your driver on the day speaks simple Japanese.
What happens if my flight is delayed?
We track your flight's arrival time and wait for you. There is no extra charge for delays.
How can I pay?
You can pay on the day in cash (KRW or JPY) or by credit card.
Is there a cancellation fee?
Cancellation is free up to the day before. Same-day cancellation is charged at 50% of the price.
